name: Rabbah

related_people.name: Hanun
related_people.role: Ammon's king, who humiliated David's envoys and drew Israel to besiege this city

related_people.name: Joab
related_people.role: led the siege of this city and summoned David for its capture

related_people.name: Shobi
related_people.role: an Ammonite of this royal city who later brought supplies to David

related_people.name: Uriah
related_people.role: set at the fiercest point of the fighting at this city and killed

description: Capital of Ammon, besieged by Joab's army in the campaign during which David arranged Uriah's death while Uriah's own unit fought at its walls (2 Samuel 11:1, 14-17). Joab later called David to finish the siege personally, and David took the city and its crown (2 Samuel 12:26-31).
